heading.title: The missing reply
heading.brief: Draw both possible histories when COMMIT’s reply disappears; make loss of a response independent of the server’s decision.

heading.title: One purchase identity

heading.title: Resolving uncertainty
heading.brief: Look up the same request through an authoritative path and retry the protocol with the same identity; distinguish absence now from proof of abort.

heading.title: Retry budgets
heading.brief: Retry a confirmed transient abort as a complete transaction with bounded backoff; keep external effects outside retried code and state retention requirements.
